BaselineRecoveryVariantEvidence.Scope: Six internal DDR recovery clock pairs only
Limitations: This audit proves report coverage and arithmetic, not reset-release safety.
Entry RDC, native pin queries and resulting exception effects need separate evidence.
Only this fixed checked candidate and its local execution/hash chain are admitted; local receipts are not cryptographic execution attestations.
Reset exceptions are exact scoped exclusions, not positive-slack reset recovery/removal measurements or analog reset safety acceptance.
MPNR reload produced native RTR and exception reports; no new XML report or routed pin report is claimed.
External IO AC budgets, CDC/skew, pullups, DDR training and hardware stability remain unaccepted.
